## Market.getSupplyApy() method

The market's instantaneous supply-side Annual Percentage Yield (APY) at the given timestamp, if the state remains unchanged (not accrued).

**Signature:**

```typescript
getSupplyApy(timestamp?: BigIntish): number;
```
